author: Kurt Pegler
title: Mason Minkel makes splash in pro golf debut - NewsBreak
text:
By Kurt Pegler ,
7 hours ago
METAMORA, Ill. (WMBD/WYZZ) — Talk about making a great debut.
Pekin’s Mason Minkel shot a 4-under 67 in his professional debut in the first round of the OSF Healthcare Children’s Hospital of Illinois Championship at Metamora Fields Golf Course on Wednesday. He is four shots off the lead.
Minkel, a former star at Pekin High School, just turned professional this summer. He had six birdies a double bogey on his scorecard.
Jimmy Morton of Aurora, Ill., Andrew Beckler of Topeka, Kan., and Matt Holuta of Winter Park, Fla. share the lead at 8-under par. Minkel finished his collegiate golf career at VCU last month.
Metamora Fields and WeaverRidge Golf Courses are paying host to the All Pro Tour event. The ANNIKA Tour is also hosting a 72-hole women’s tournament in conjunction with the APT stop.
Tiffany Lee of Covina, Calif. shot a 7-under 64 and grabbed a one-shot lead of the women’s tour event.
